note: Photos access (submodule of Photos) adds per-album privacy: Open(0)/Locked(1)/User list(2)/Password(3), enforced via node access grants. Its master switch is the parent config flag photos.settings:photos_access_<type> (photos_access_photos for the 'photos' album type); per-album state lives in DB tables photos_access_album (viewid,pass) and photos_access_user, and the password page is /photos_privacy/pass/{node}. It has no config schema or permissions of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the safe master-switch config flag photos_access_photos (config-only). Per-album privacy (the viewid in photos_access_album) requires a real album node; that path is deliberately NOT exercised here to avoid node create/delete on the shared site. Treated as a lighter submodule: 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard.

evals.prompt: What per-album privacy options does the Drupal photos_access submodule provide, and how is each stored?
evals.expected_output: Each album can be Open, Locked (owner only), User list (specific users), or Password protected. The choice is stored per album in the photos_access_album table as viewid 0=Open, 1=Locked, 2=User list, 3=Password (with a hashed pass for password mode).

evals.prompt: How do I turn on the photos_access album privacy features for the Photos album content type? Which config flag controls it?
evals.expected_output: Album privacy is active only when the parent module flag photos.settings:photos_access_<type> is true - photos_access_photos for the 'photos' album type. The privacy fields and node-access hooks only apply when that flag is set.

evals.prompt: How does photos_access enforce album privacy, and where do anonymous visitors enter an album password?
evals.expected_output: It uses Drupal's node access system (hook_node_access_records + hook_node_grants) to grant/deny album view. Visitors enter an album password at /photos_privacy/pass/{node} (route photos_access.page), which stores a session grant.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is photos_access album privacy currently active for the Photos album content type? Inspect the live configuration and report the value of the controlling flag.
evals.expected_output: Yes - photos.settings:photos_access_photos is 1, so album privacy is enabled for the photos album type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using photos_access, turn ON album privacy for the Photos album content type so that albums can be set to Locked/User-list/Password. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: photos.settings:photos_access_photos is set to 1 (album privacy enabled for the photos type).
